seeds_fidelity_schedule.policy: Successive fidelity multi-seed elimination frozen BEFORE first optimizer evaluation. Seed order, stage budgets, and selection statistic declared here; final rank uses declared multi-seed stage, never single-seed re-ranking. No cherry-picking per-seed-per-candidate for final decision.

stages.seed_set: S_1 = {0} declared (or {0} fixed per manifests/agsdr_local_seeds.json S0 field)
stages.purpose: Coarse elimination over 5-D theta_local box; rank on hard feasibility + Pareto soft; eliminate infeasible and dominated
stages.selection: Keep N1=8 survivors: all HARD-PASS (H01-H12 per agsdr_local_objectives.json), then Pareto non-dominated on (J_rates,J_irregularity,J_synchrony,J_Fano,J_hetero,J_EI,J_CL1C) with w=1/6 tie-breaker only among non-dominated (optimization_policy Pareto). Eliminate remainder regardless of single scalar.
stages.budget_note: 24x1 cheap; mirrors B1/B2 smoke cost ~5s per 2000ms at n=400 dt0.1; parallel across 24 workers

stages.seed_set: S_2 = {0,1} declared frozen (or {0,1} or {7,19} non-adjacent pair — declared in seeds.json, not chosen post-hoc)
stages.purpose: Refine survivors with seed heterogeneity estimate; detect seed-sensitive PV cliff (r_PV 6.37 vs 14.08) and VIP tail variance
stages.selection_statistic: For each scalar y (bar_r, rho, CV_mean, Fano, Efrac_proxy), compute cross-seed mean y_bar = mean_{s in S_2} y(s) and SE; rank uses y_bar not best seed. Also report max-min spread as robustness. Pareto uses y_bar.
stages.selection: Keep N2=3 finalists: hard PASS on y_bar (all seeds individually must be finite and no seed >80/<0.5 for E) and Pareto on y_bar distributions. Require protected P(CV_E>0.5)_bar >=0.15 and max_bar >=1.5 on mean across seeds.
stages.no_cherry_pick: Final set not defined as 'best seed among 2 per candidate'; declared mean is the ranking statistic. Single-seed outlier improvement does not promote.

stages.seed_set: S_4 = {0,1,2,3} declared frozen (or {0,1,2,3} or {0,7,14,21} stratified — frozen choice in seeds.json)
stages.purpose: Confirmation with 4-seed distribution; estimate Jacobian dY_k/d theta_j and finalize one theta* for Ledger
stages.selection_statistic: Per-candidate y_bar_4 = mean_{s in S_4} y(s); 95% CI via t_{3}; report pooled distribution P(y) not just mean. Final model theta* is argmin among N2 of Pareto y_bar_4 (or scalar w=1/6 tie-breaker). Single-seed final claim forbidden.
stages.selection: Choose exactly 1 theta* (theta_star) to advance to ledger GEN2_C019: must be hard PASS on all 4 seeds pooled (no seed violates H01/H10 hyper>80 / silence<0.5) and best Pareto y_bar_4. If tie, lower var across seeds wins (stability). Document all 3 finalists' 4-seed receipts even for non-selected.
stages.final_ledger_rule: theta_star enters ledger as single delta parent be9b96ab -> new hash; other N0+N1+N2-1 candidates remain as evidence artifacts under results/agsdr_local/ not ledger forks. No post-hoc switch to seed0-best among S4.

totals.seeds_reused: Seeds 0..3 reused across stages but frozen selection forbids cherry-picking; earlier S0 single-seed rank never overrides later multi-seed mean
anti_cherry_pick_rules: Seed sets S_1,S_2,S_4 frozen in manifests/agsdr_local_seeds.json BEFORE first optimizer evaluation; optimizer code may not change them adaptively.

Stage transition keeps top N by declared stage statistic (S0 uses 1-seed, S1 uses 2-seed mean, S2 uses 4-seed mean); never re-rank earlier stage with later seeds to promote a previously eliminated candidate.
Final theta_star selected on S2 4-seed mean (or Pareto of means), not on max_{s in S4} y(s) nor on seed0 alone. Reporting must show per-seed table + mean; claim based on seed0 alone is invalid.
Elimination is monotonic: once eliminated at S0 or S1, candidate never reinstated via single good seed; ledger preserves attribution single theta_star edge.
All stages use same 2000ms window and same dt 0.1; no window-length tuning per seed.

parallel_topology.description: Evaluations are embarrassingly parallel per theta; evaluators are parallel per metric; AGSDR learns Jacobian dY_k/d theta_j for local linearization.
parallel_topology.diagram: theta1 || theta2 || ... || thetaN  [each builds model via jomission/network/builder.py:318 build_jomission_network n_per_area100 && jaxfne.io.config_hash -> 2000ms simulation] -> per-theta records (spikes, V_m, traces, edge_current proxy) -> evaluators E_rates || E_B2 || E_EI || E_CL1C (each reads same artifacts, computes one J_k) -> join per candidate valid/feasible/J_vector -> parent/AGSDR updates proposal distribution P(theta) via Pareto ranking (optimization_policy feasible-first) -> learns Jacobian dY_k/d theta_j by local finite differences across nearby thetas (e.g., delta g_fastEI +0.15 => delta rho, delta P(CV>0.5))

theta_parallel.spec: N independent simulations (N = N0 or N1 or N2) dispatched as array job; each simulation deterministic per seed (builder.py seeds), no shared RNG, no controller state coupling; config_hash + seed uniquely identifies realization.
theta_parallel.resource: per sim ~2000ms *400 neurons dt0.1 = 8e6 steps *n_edges ~10k ; O(400*4624/0.1) memory ~74MB V_m per trial per ledger.py RESOURCE_ESTIMATE; exposure_batch_size 11 for 38GB OOM guard per factorial_v0p2_fast.py:198,383

evaluator_parallel.E_rates: computes bar_r, per-class r_E/PV/SST/VIP, coverage>=60%, E<PV from spikes (jomission/qualification/b1_targets.py + gen2_gates.py:117-138 B1)
evaluator_parallel.E_B2: computes CV_rate, CV_ISI per neuron, Fano median[0.7,2.0], mean rho[-0.05,0.2] hard<0.60, rho(d) slope>0.05 from binned correlations (gen2_gates.py:139-154 + ledger RESOURCE_ESTIMATE)
evaluator_parallel.E_EI: computes Efrac proxy via partition_currents_by_motif W·r·tau (jomission/recording/observables.py:34-156) until jaxfne supports edge_current with delays; flags PROXY_LIMITED (gen2_gates.py:156-164 B3)
evaluator_parallel.E_CL1C: computes PV+50%/SST+50%/VIP+50% and additive +2.0 perturbations vs baseline same seed (review_CL1v2_functional); deltas r_PV, rho, E, SST (manifests/agsdr_local_objectives.json J_CL1C)
evaluator_parallel.note: Evaluators share same per-theta artifacts but compute disjoint J_k; embarrassingly parallel after simulation join; no cross-evaluator leakage to T1-T7

proposal_update.AGSDR_step: Parent/AGSDR receives per-candidate feasible+J_vector and updates proposal distribution P_{t+1}(theta) supported on theta_local 5-D box [0.25,0.45] etc. Use feasible-first Pareto: keep non-dominated feasible set; scalar w=1/6 only tie-breaks among non-dominated (manifests/agsdr_local_objectives.json optimization_policy). Proposal may be Bayesian optimization or evolutionary; frozen equal weights w_k=1/6 per B10 SPECIFIED, not empirical T weighting.

jacobian_learning.estimate: Jacobian dY_k/d theta_j ≈ (Y_k(theta + delta e_j) - Y_k(theta - delta e_j))/(2 delta) using nearby candidates within same stage (finite differences). AGSDR maintains running linear surrogate Y ≈ Y0 + J (theta - theta0) for local acquisition; not a cortical mechanism, external optimizer state.
jacobian_learning.use: Guides next proposal toward Pareto improvement: e.g., positive d(rho)/d(g_rec) suggests lower g_rec reduces sync; positive d(P_CV>0.5)/d(g_background private variance) quantifies trade-off noted in c011_counterexample where bar_r improvement co-degraded rho; Jacobian makes trade-off explicit.
jacobian_learning.store: Per-stage jacobian_estimate.json with 5xK matrix and se across seeds (se over S_2 or S_4 means).

proposal_update.one_delta_ledger: Only one theta_star advances to ledger GEN2_C019 (f3707cd->be9b96ab style single edge per C018); attribution preserved via reason_before_results before observed_generic_effect (ledger.py:18-20 invariants SPECIFIED->IMPLEMENTED->TESTED->OBSERVED)
